agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/sql.py: Parenthesis._groupable_tokens was incorrectly `self.tokens[1:-2]`, causing group_where (in sqlparse/engine/grouping.py) to mis-bound WHERE clauses located inside parenthesized subqueries when no closing keyword (ORDER BY/GROUP BY/etc.) follows the WHERE within that parenthesis - the closing punctuation of the enclosing parenthesis could get swallowed into or excluded incorrectly from the Where group. Reverted to the correct `self.tokens[1:-1]`, matching the analogous SquareBrackets implementation. Verified with manual test script covering WHERE inside a FROM-subquery, WHERE ... IN (subselect WHERE ...), plain WHERE ... ORDER BY, and WHERE (condition) - all now produce correctly nested token trees with the closing parenthesis properly placed outside the Where group. This restores the 'grouping where' and 'issue9' behaviors.
